Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly pivoted from ACM to IEEE, asserting that the “Communications” publication more likely referred to IEEE Communications Magazine based on keyword similarity. This ignored the clearer match “Communications of the ACM” tied to Zhang’s ACM fellowship and led to pursuing the wrong group and publisher. The correct publisher is Association for Computing Machinery (ACM), not IEEE/ComSoc.
